title.zh: US targets $1 billion Iran-linked crypto seizure, Bessent says ‘we know where it is’
title.en: US targets $1 billion Iran-linked crypto seizure, Bessent says ‘we know where it is’

current_state.zh: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the government has located roughly $1 billion in Iran-linked cryptocurrency it aims to seize, the latest step in a months-long campaign of sanctions and asset freezes against Iranian holdings.
current_state.en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the government has located roughly $1 billion in Iran-linked cryptocurrency it aims to seize, the latest step in a months-long campaign of sanctions and asset freezes against Iranian holdings.
